name: How Do We Know God Exists
overview: Scripture reveals God's existence through both creation and revelation. The heavens and the earth proclaim His handiwork, demonstrating His eternal nature as the Creator from everlasting to everlasting. Humanity, made in God's own image, reflects His divine nature, while the Word, who was with God and was God, reveals Him fully. Though no one has seen God directly, the only begotten Son has made Him known to us, inviting sincere seekers to find Him through wholehearted pursuit.
